scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @daytrace/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @daytrace/site typecheck
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:packages && tsx --test packages/config/src/*.test.ts packages/contracts/src/*.test.ts apps/api/src/common/*.test.ts apps/api/src/modules/content/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:packages && tsx --tsconfig apps/api/tsconfig.json --test tests/integration/api.integration.test.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @daytrace/api build && pnpm --filter @daytrace/site build
